column4: A gloved puppeteer's hand holds a simple wooden puppet control bar obliquely against a deep coal field; elegant cuff, fingers and hanging points visually separate, several threads hanging down. Calm, deliberate, not aggressive.

Closed heavy coal theater curtains in a grand gothic proscenium with a clean center seam and broad engraved folds, an ornate orange valance and tassels, the stage lip visible below. Both halves readable as separate slabs.

A vast gothic cathedral turned theater, viewed from the rear aisle toward a raised wooden stage; a huge rose window and a tall leaded window bay high above the stage; rows of pews, hanging chandeliers, banners, candles, ribbed vaults and many layered arches. Keep the stage floor clear for puppets; the main information sits in the central 16:9 area.
